notes.f1: Child (Lydia Grice, daughter of Hannah Earnest) correctly identified and correctly linked to both parents in the tree (R15 Edwin -> Lydia, R16 Hannah -> Lydia, both sourced to S1, the 1891 census), with an exact-match Christening fact (8 August 1878, Holy Trinity West Bromwich, sourced to S5) -- the exact record the finding names. Graded true, not partial: this fixture's calibration has consistently graded this exact gap shape (right child, right parents, exact christening, missing only the precise birth day) true, not partial -- 07-07, 07-22 (x3), 07-27, 08-23, 09-09, 09-14, 10-05 and 11-11 all graded true on this reasoning, and the 07-07 note states it explicitly: recording year-only, sourced to the christening, 'is the epistemically correct call, not a shortcoming.' The tree's birth fact (F33, also sourced to S5) brackets the date to 'Bet Apr 1878 and 8 Aug 1878' -- tighter than the 11-18 run's 'Bet 1878 and 1879,' which was also graded true on identical reasoning. The run's own proof narrative states the exact day 'is not recorded in any source seen,' which is the run correctly declining to assert an unattested date, not a miss. The partial grades elsewhere in this fixture's history (09-21, 09-28, 10-13, 10-30) are a different gap shape -- no christening recovered at all, or the parent relationship missing from the tree entirely -- not this one. Proof quality graded 2 (thin): the run's own exhaustive_search_summary lists multiple searches left incomplete rather than exhausted -- the civil Birth Registration Index pass left 3,847 of 3,897 rows unread (only 50 rows actually read), and the 1901 census, wills/administrations, a Staffordshire BMD fallback, Darlaston Methodist/St George registers by year, adjoining districts, and death/burial indexes were all named but not run -- and the narrative itself concedes 'the completeness of the child set is therefore not established.'
